_meta.description: The public gaps ledger: known unknowns and provisional values awaiting verification. Check here before treating an absence in the KB as an oversight. Game questions only.

questions.topic: Melding Construct AR % per rank
questions.detail: RESOLVED 2026-08-25 (maintainer-ruled): rank-5 total is +20% equipment AR, measured — it reconciled a rank-5 owner's armor readings (archive-corroborated, 2026-08-21). Per-rank +4% is the assumed-linear split by analogy with other linear mastery lines. See const:melding-pct-per-rank.

questions.topic: Health-Factor mastery interaction with the L60 HP ratio
questions.detail: How +0.2-class Health Factor lines combine with the effective spec ratio (additive to the ratio per dev structure, but magnitude unvalidated at L60).

questions.topic: Combat HP ratio 3.6 unvalidated
questions.detail: Stealth 2.8 validated exact and Magic 2.2 within 1 HP; no Combat-spec L60 measurement on file. Also: Magic 2.2 vs 2.19 rounding.

questions.topic: Piece AR at armor skill above 100
questions.detail: Item-fortified skill scales linearly (verified at 105/118), but one observed character with mastery-raised skill 125 shows a piece reading as if the +25 counts double (250 vs linear 208). Candidate causes: CM-sourced skill points scaling differently, another skill contributing, or an unidentified mechanic. Linear is the well-verified model; tools may underestimate for cap-raised characters until resolved.

questions.topic: Is the Atronach magicka drain live in the current era?
questions.detail: Dev-described drain (5% of max, per the 0.8 doc line 'Damage Magicka on Self') confirmed as a 2023 nerf; current-era status unconfirmed. Stopwatch test: Atronach character, full bar, stand still 60s.

questions.topic: Native health regen
questions.detail: No evidence of any native health regen (vanilla has none); one stopwatch test at partial health settles it.

questions.topic: Unexplained magicka/fatigue surplus on one measured character
questions.detail: RESOLVED 2026-08-25 (maintainer-ruled): the magicka half was the old formula (see formula:magicka - 3.85x is exactly spec + sign + level). The +126 fatigue surplus on the one affected character is presumed a character-specific backend bug (likely from a forced dev-side mastery respec while werewolf; the maintainer had reported the character to the dev, who may also have fixed related backend state). It is NOT modeled as a mechanic; formula:fatigue stands as measured on all clean characters. If a second character ever shows a fatigue surplus, reopen.

questions.topic: Possible level factor on the 1x INT magicka base
questions.detail: A level-1 character read 0.9x INT naked — below the 1x base. Level factor, or sign/racial detail; needs the character's birthsign and one mid-level reading.

questions.topic: Fatigue level-bonus curve between L1 (+1) and L60 (+55)
questions.detail: One mid-level naked reading pins the curve (candidate: floor(0.9 x level) + 1).

questions.topic: Masteries added after the wiki snapshot
questions.detail: Jan-2026 combat AoE masteries 'Rend' and 'Cleave', a claimed 'Combo Focus 4' (wiki has ranks 1-3), and an unidentified 'Destruction max [75]' mastery are absent from the catalog — stubs exist in masteries.json. Fix: capture /cm in-game or a fresh wiki save.

questions.topic: Do enchant magnitude ceilings scale with anvil-upgraded EV?
questions.detail: If linear, +55 EV on jewelry/clothing would roughly triple ring enchant ceilings. One test enchant on an upgraded blank settles it.

questions.topic: Grand Belt self-enchant baseline
questions.detail: No enchanted belt example observed; inferred ~29 (shirt-class), unverified.

questions.topic: Is the re-equip-during-enchant EV trick still live?
questions.detail: Historically reached 47 pts on a ~20-24 EV ring; possibly patched since.

questions.topic: Terminology: 'CM points' vs the 1500-cap mastery-point pool
questions.detail: Smaller 'CM cap' figures (125/175) appear alongside the 25xlevel pool in community usage; whether these describe one pool or two systems is not explicitly stated anywhere on file.

questions.topic: Rehabilitator Anja refunds vs the free L60 Ergalla respec
questions.detail: Same mechanism, complementary, or one superseded? Both treated as valid until reconciled.

questions.topic: Do purchased birthsign-gated masteries (120 pts) refund on birthsign change?
Boss Sanctuary/crit scaling when event-buffed
questions.detail: One adjacent 2020 claim says world-boss event scaling manifests mainly as resistances.

questions.topic: Emperor Crab resistance drift across patches
questions.detail: Fresh in-game check advised before relying on older resist values.

questions.topic: Focused Strike linear proc model verification
questions.detail: proc% = 0.30 x Agility is an expert player statement adopted as working truth; a one-time in-game count-test would confirm the linear model and the ~334 threshold.

questions.topic: Hit damage formula on NP
questions.detail: best_strike_max x (STR+50)/100 is vanilla-structure, adopted by community tools; not formally validated on NP. Condition/armor-reduction interaction with DISPLAYED AR also unverified.

questions.topic: When/why the planned level cap 100 became 60
questions.detail: Historical curiosity; 60 is definitively current.

questions.topic: Vampire bloodline passive magnitudes
questions.detail: Bloodlines carry substantial passive buffs; magnitudes not yet captured (wiki page pending ingest).

questions.topic: Speed cap 350 vs 175
questions.detail: See contradictions c:speed-cap.

questions.topic: House abandonment rule
questions.detail: See contradictions c:house-abandonment.

questions.topic: Enchanted-item recharge mechanics
questions.detail: See contradictions c:enchant-recharge.

questions.topic: Which vanilla items NP has modified
questions.detail: RESOLVED for the 50 vanilla-named items with full NP captures, via data/vanilla_ref.json (parsed from the game ESMs, 2026-08-23). ESM-verified NP changes: Wraithguard and Marara's Ring Reflect nerfed 20->10 (Marara's also lost vanilla's Fortify Acrobatics 10); Nordic Silver Battleaxe retuned (Chop 5-50 -> 25-45, weight 30->22); Stormfang slightly nerfed (all dmg maxima -2 to -3, weight 30->27); armor AR systematically reduced (~half of vanilla for most pieces: Daedric Cuirass/Greaves/Savior's Hide 266->133 AR@100, Ebony Mail 333->166, Darksun 200->100; some helms cut further: Oreyn Bearclaw 300->76, Masque of Clavicus Vile 266->68). CORRECTED: earlier versions of this question claimed NP buffed artifact damage (Sunder 60->70, Goldbrand 45->50, Hopesfire 55->70, Eltonbrand 55->60, Skull Crusher 50->60) and Mantle of Woe 0.5x->5.0x - ALL FALSE: those NP values are identical to the vanilla ESM; the 'vanilla' side of each claim was memory-sourced. REMAINING: vanilla-named items without full NP tooltip captures, and non-equipment records.

questions.topic: Weapon speed% to attacks-per-second conversion
questions.detail: The KB stores speed_pct per weapon but has no formula converting it into swing rate, so cross-weapon DPS comparisons (e.g. Keening 250% vs Sunder 150%) are directional only. Resolution: time N swings of two weapons with known speed% at fixed conditions.

questions.topic: Masteries cited by build posts but absent from the wiki capture
questions.detail: 'Champion Master Class' (arch:ascetic-augmenter) and 'Disenchant' (arch:upgrader-enchanter) are claimed in community build posts but have no wiki-captured record — cost/effects/requirements unknown. Stubs added to masteries.json. Resolution: in-game tooltip screenshots or a newer wiki dump.

questions.topic: Rules on stealing from / pickpocketing other players
questions.detail: server_rules.json covers PvP griefing and exploit bans but says nothing about pickpocketing, looting player corpses, or taking from player homes/containers. Unknown whether it is permitted, banned, or mechanically impossible. Resolution: ask staff in Discord and capture the answer with a date.

questions.topic: Recommended level ranges for the elemental tier-1 / event camps
questions.detail: The grind-camp level-range table doesn't cover the elemental atronach camps or event camps (e.g. the 2026 Infernal Flame camp). Only qualitative difficulty signals exist (resist-stack requirements, death reports). Resolution: collect community consensus per camp with dates.

questions.topic: Racial base attributes / skill bonuses
questions.detail: races.json captures the 0.8 rework special abilities only — no base attribute or skill-bonus tables. Unknown whether NP kept vanilla racial base stats or reworked them. Resolution: dev doc check or per-race fresh-character readings.

questions.topic: Weapons with uncaptured damage or speed
questions.detail: 7 captured weapons have no damage values (Sparkler, Snowman Balls, Fireracer Launcher, Ouch, Stalhrim Shortsword, Witches' Broom, Seasplitter) and ~117 have no speed_pct. Most tooltips exist as images/items/*.png — an OCR pass or fresh in-game reads would close this. Builder impact: DPS/speed display incomplete for these.

questions.topic: NP-custom alchemy ingredients
questions.detail: Server-added ingredients partially identified: Elemental Flame Dust (2026 Infernal Flame Atronach Camp drop, in-game chat 2026-08-09; stub record ingr:elemental-flame-dust) and an unnamed fireshield-fish drop (in-game chat 2026-08-03). Effects, weights, values unknown for all. Resolution: in-game tooltip screenshots of each ingredient -> alchemy.json np_ingredients. (Checked: 'Sticky Cinnamon Taffy' is Jiubsmas throwing ammo, not an ingredient.)

questions.topic: NP modifications to alchemy / enchanting / repair processes
questions.detail: Vanilla baselines documented in data/vanilla_processes.json. Alchemy-side NP deltas now partially recorded as mechanics facts (fact:potion-effect-caps, fact:potion-active-limit-values, fact:potions-per-combine, fact:player-goods-no-npc-value, fact:skills-not-potion-fortifiable): NP caps potion magnitude/duration, limits active potions, yields multiple potions per combine, and zeroes NPC resale. Still unknown: the potion strength formula itself, exact cap values per effect, and enchanting/repair process deltas. Resolution: patch notes, in-game measurement.

questions.topic: Active-potion limit curve and semantics
questions.detail: Dev-stated 2019 curve now on record: 3/4/5/6 at <50/50-74/75-99/100+ (fact:potion-active-limit-values). Current-era player consensus says 5 at 100 — see c:active-potion-limit; one in-game count at Alchemy 100 (no Cowl) resolves it. Still open: whether the limit is per potion type, and the slot-free timing (the limit clearing on death IS settled — dev-stated 2022-06-02).

questions.topic: Potions-per-combine composition
questions.detail: Observed: 5 potions per combine fully equipped (fact:potions-per-combine). Claimed contributors: Secret Master apparatus text '+2 additional potions per brew' (upstream, per piece — likely a set-level description copied across pieces), Metabolist '+1 potion count', Miraculous Mix '+1 if Immunity also owned', Miraculous Mix 'doubles Explosive Eureka / Refining Agent output'. These do not obviously sum to 5. Resolution: controlled combines varying one factor at a time.

questions.topic: Apparatus tier impact on final potion potency
questions.detail: Does apparatus tier still change final potency at max perk/skill investment? The current-era meta includes the full Secret Master set, but an era-2022 report claimed plain Master apparatus sufficed at max perks — see c:secret-master-apparatus-impact. Related unverified claim: higher-quality calcinator lowers brewed potion weight (server-general 2025-06-04). Resolution: same-ingredient brews across apparatus tiers at maxed stats.

questions.topic: How souls work on NP
questions.detail: Souls were deliberately left out of the vanilla ingest because the system is believed reworked. Working hypothesis (maintainer, unverified): a soul's ENCHANT charge value is unchanged from vanilla, but its GOLD value to merchants was nerfed. Resolution: in-game check of two or three filled gems — compare tooltip charge and merchant offer against vanilla values (vanilla creature souls are parseable from the ESMs on demand once this is settled). Dev-stated context now on record: Soul Gem Synthesis (perk, 1-hour cooldown, 2019-09-19); Black Soul Gems at Grand capacity usable for self-resurrection (2022-07-23). Neither announcement states soul charge or merchant-gold values — the hypothesis still needs the in-game check.

questions.topic: True magicka pool formula: level-scaled multiplier suspected
questions.detail: Two clean naked readings (L1: 27 = 0.9 x INT 30 exact - dev spec factor live, base is NOT 1 x INT; L60: 469 vs 470 predicted under mult = spec + carriers + 0.025 x level) contradict the old pool = min(INT,cap) x (1+racial+sign). See c:magicka-base-multiplier for positions and the decisive test list. Consistent one-short offset at L60 in both magicka and HP suggests per-level floor accumulation. RESOLVED 2026-08-25: level-scaled model adopted and encoded in formula:magicka after a third clean reading (L60 Altmer/Atronach 712 = floor(125 x 5.7) exact).

questions.topic: Player services — uncaptured details
questions.detail: Housing: per-home upkeep amounts and the house building/customization system beyond purchase. Glamours: the Analyzer's cell/location name and the prerequisites that raise Glamour Storage capacity above 10. Login Points: whether event periods boost the 18/login rate.

questions.topic: Combo Focus 4 cost and level gate
questions.detail: Rank 4 is confirmed real (the wiki added it 2026-08-19, after the KB's export; proc-frequency publicly measured) but its MP cost and level requirement are only on the bot-blocked wiki page. One manual export/screenshot of the current Mastery Points page closes this and lets the builder budget the rank.

questions.topic: Systematic pre-0.8 era audit (old-server pollution sweep)
questions.detail: SWEEP COMPLETED 2026-08-26 over every camp + the discord-sourced files: archetypes.json (all build threads post-launch), alchemy.json, and items.json audited CLEAN; lore.json already carries its 0.7-era convention. Quarantined as old-server-unverified: Roach/Kushtashpi, Shalk, and Skree (no evidence after the 2022-05-13 launch); Emperor Crab BOSS details flagged pre-0.8-sourced (the mudcrab camp itself is wiki-current). Six mechanics records annotated with pre-0.8 era-provenance (three server-tunable ones were briefly provisional but are maintainer-confirmed current, 2026-08-26). REMAINING: current-era confirmation for the three engine-quirk records (Cure school, Slow Fall, jump momentum) + Emperor Crab/Skree; capture the DRAUGR camp the 2026 XP sheet lists.

questions.topic: Which 3 factors govern fish-boss spawning
questions.detail: Of the player-guessed factors {weather, location, time of day, bait, skill level}, the dev confirmed 'i can confirm 3 of these are correct assumptions' (2025-07-14) but never said which three. Bait quality is separately dev-confirmed to matter. Settling this needs a dev statement or systematic spawn logging.

questions.topic: Fishing level cap vs Master Bait unlock
questions.detail: Players treat fishing level 10 as the major milestone ('750+ hours'), but Master Bait is player-reported to unlock at fishing level 13 ('13, usually', 2025-08-08). Either levels run past 10 or one report is wrong; no dev statement found.

questions.topic: Is fishing in player homes blocked or bugged
questions.detail: A 2025-06-02 dev note said a bobbers-in-player-homes bug fix was in progress (implying it was meant to work); later in-game chat (2026-08-10) flatly lists player housing among no-fishing zones. Unresolved whether it was removed or remains bugged/blocked.

questions.topic: Do fishing tournaments exist on the current server
questions.detail: The OLD server's 2021-01-11 fishing launch included weekly/monthly largest-fish tournaments via the Fishing Guru. The 2025-06-02 relaunch notes do not mention tournaments and no current-era archive mention was found. Old-server history until sighted.
